mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ra_ai_analysis_query_session WHERE expires_at_ms <= #{now} ORDER BY expires_at_ms,id LIMIT 1000
mapper.select: SELECT id,owner_doctor_id AS ownerDoctorId,scope_fingerprint AS scopeFingerprint,sort_key AS sortKey,query_version AS payloadVersion,query_json AS queryJson,as_of_date AS asOfDate,policy_fingerprint AS policyFingerprint,created_at_ms AS createdAtMs,expires_at_ms AS expiresAtMs FROM ra_ai_analysis_query_session WHERE id=#{id}
